## registry check

Check an image registry

Requires the `rel.environments` `read` setting. Tries the stored settings and pull credentials against the registry.

```bash
nb-studio registry check <registry>
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `registry` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/read`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/registries/{registryId}/check` (`releasesCheckRegistry`)

## registry create

Create an image registry

Requires the `rel.environments` `manage` setting. The pull password is write-only and never returned.

```bash
nb-studio registry create [<registry>]
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `registry` | (optional)  |

| Flag               | Type   | Description                                                       |
| ------------------ | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`           | string |                                                                   |
| `--url`            | string |                                                                   |
| `--namespace`      | string |                                                                   |
| `--pull-username`  | string |                                                                   |
| `--secret-changes` | json   |                                                                   |
| `--file`           | path   | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/manage`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/registries` (`releasesCreateRegistry`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio registry create ghcr --name GHCR --url https://ghcr.io --namespace my-org
```

## registry delete

Delete an image registry

Requires the `rel.environments` `manage` setting.

```bash
nb-studio registry delete <registry>
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `registry` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                          |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete the image registry?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/manage`.

**Request:** `DELETE /api/releases/registries/{registryId}` (`releasesDeleteRegistry`)
